parties: Gnanesh D. Gala | Navneet Education Limited
headline: Gnanesh D. Gala Files SEBI Regulation 31(4) Disclosure for Navneet Education
sum: Gnanesh D. Gala has submitted a SEBI Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure to NSE, signaling a potential material change in ownership or control thresholds at Navneet Education Limited.
implication: Regulation 31(4) filings are mandatory when an acquirer crosses key ownership thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, or 75%) or enters into a voting agreement; the disclosure mechanics are often the gating item in multi-stage M&A and require careful timing coordination with open offers or board consent.
detail: Gnanesh D. Gala has formally disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares or voting rights in Navneet Education Limited under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4). The filing was submitted to the NSE on or around 23 June 2026. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure when an acquirer (a) crosses 25%, 50%, or 75% ownership thresholds; or (b) enters into a voting agreement materially affecting control. The precise quantum of shares and consideration are not disclosed in the regulatory notice itself, being reserved for the full disclosure form filed with the exchange.
